dukūla.cp: neut. a kind of very fine cloth.
dukūla.p: [Du+kū(ku)la+a] (pu,na) CL=8 Duma+kūla. Dukkhena kulyateti dukūlaṃ, dumehi jātaṃ kūlanti vā dukūlaṃ. Dhāna, ṭī. 291. Du+ula. Thoma.] (pu)  (1) named Dukūla., (u) Baby, boy, young man. Dukūlakumāra- see also. Wisdom hermit. Dukūlapaṇḍita - see also. (Na) (2) fabulous cotton. (3) fabulous Puso (nether garment for man), garment/ nether garment for man which is made of cotteon. See original. Dukūlasandana -see also. (pu) (3) also see the meaning. (4) garment which is made of Khoma cotton. (5) garment which is made of silk. (6) fine clothes. (7) two sides bank. (Ti) (8) it should be made the fubulous clothes, (A) cape/cloak, scarf. (B) robe (for Bhikkhus).
pn: Dukūla (Dukūlaka). A hunter’s son, father of Suvaṇṇasāma. He is identified with Mahā Kassapa. For his story see the Sāmajātaka (Ja 540). See also Mil.123; Vin-a.i.214.

dukūlasandana.p: [Dukūla+sandana(sandāna] (ti) CL=8 Sandhana)]  (a) have the flooring that is Bhvaဲ့phrū puchiuḥ. (b) Bhvaဲ့phrū puchiuḥ has flow of milk.
